<think>
To answer this question, we need to:
1. Identify visitors who have visited more than once.
2. Select the id, name, and age of these visitors.
</think>

```sql
SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Age
FROM visitor v
WHERE v.ID IN (
    SELECT visitor_ID
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);
